versions.changelog:
- Initial upload of custom UX/UI skill

This skill would function as your personal UX/UI specialist. It could:

• Analyze Designs: Evaluate your designed interfaces (for apps or websites) based on best practices, accessibility standards (WCAG), and specific platform guidelines (like Google Material Design or Apple Human Interface Guidelines).
• Compare Solutions: Help you choose between different design options (e.g., navigation methods, UI elements), explaining their pros, cons, and suitability for your project.
• Explain Principles: Clarify fundamental UX/UI concepts, methodologies (like user research, importance of accessibility), and guidelines.
• Provide Recommendations: Offer specific advice on how to improve user experience, ensure accessibility, and optimize interfaces, based on professional standards.
• Solve Problems: Assist in identifying potential design issues and suggest solutions.

In short, it would be your digital consultant, helping you create better, more user-friendly, and accessible products.
